## ⚠️ IMPORTANT - READ FIRST

**Extension submissions should be made via Pull Request to the [nodellm/extensions](https://github.com/nodellm-io/extensions) repository, NOT as an issue here.**

This issue template is for:
- ✅ Announcing/discussing your extension before submission
- ✅ Asking questions about the submission process
- ✅ Getting feedback on your idea

**To actually submit your extension:**
1. Read the [Extension Submission Guide](https://github.com/nodellm-io/extensions/blob/main/SUBMISSIONS.md)
2. Use the [Extension Template](https://github.com/nodellm-io/extensions/blob/main/EXTENSION_TEMPLATE.md)
3. Fork [nodellm-io/extensions](https://github.com/nodellm-io/extensions)
4. Create a Pull Request with your extension code

## 💬 Questions or Feedback?

Before submitting, consider posting in [GitHub Discussions → Extension Submissions](https://github.com/nodellm-io/nodellm/discussions/categories/extension-submissions) to:
- Get early feedback on your idea
- Connect with other extension developers
- Ask questions about the submission process
